documentation_state.target_audience: governance leads, pack authors, charter service contributors, contract consumers

friendly_name: Charter conceptual model, user journeys and scenarios
purpose_context: The operator and the agent agreed a conceptual model of Charter Packs in conversation (docs/context/conceptual-model.md). This mission formalizes it, adds eleven user journeys with diagrams and BDD scenarios, moves the charter glossary into this repository, and records the design changes in architecture pages and ADRs, so the domain model, DTOs and storage can be redesigned from an agreed meaning.
purpose_tldr: Write down what packs, the charter, mission types and profiles mean, and how people use them, before changing the service's technical model.
